relevance_note: The paper describes a case of A20 haploinsufficiency, reporting that "A heterozygous mutation of TNFAIP3 (c.305A>G, p. Asn 102 Ser) was identified in the patient" and the same variant in her father and brother.
method_note: Case report; the paper contains no data tables, so all values come from the prose and the figure legends (Figure 1, Figure 2, Figure 3), which are quoted verbatim. Labels: the paper gives no names or patient numbers, so the proband is labelled 'patient' (rule 5) and the three relatives 'father of patient', 'brother of patient', 'sister of patient' (rule 2, relation as written). No script was used and no table was transcribed by a script: the paper has no tables, and all rows were written by hand from my reading of the prose and legends. The 80 phenotype_checklist rows are 4 in-scope individuals x 20 features. Every span, including the en-dashes in 'Figures 1A–C' and '19.3–25.8g/L', was checked character by character against the Markdown. Persons in scope: the patient (HA20, TNFAIP3 c.305A>G), her father and brother (same variant, oral ulcers) and her pregnant sister (Sanger-tested, variant absent). Her 'other family members without TNFAIP3 mutation' are mentioned only as a group and get no rows. Scope exclusions applied: the homozygous STRA8 and UEVLD variants found by WES are dismissed by the authors as not associated with the phenotype ('these were not associated with the phenotype of intestinal ulcer and vasculitis'), so no variant rows were made for them; NEMO, C2 and NOD2/CARD15 are named without any printed variant. The sister has no variants row (Sanger sequencing found no TNFAIP3 mutation in her) and no phenotypic_features rows: the only finding reported for her is the decreased A20 protein level, which is a functional assay result rather than a clinical feature, so it is recorded in variants.functional_evidence_statement of the variant rows for the three carriers and in her checklist 'not reported' statuses. Normal findings were recorded as the abnormality ruled out per D-27: 'Serum IgG and IgM were within the normal range' gives excluded rows for elevated IgG and elevated IgM, while the elevated CRP and ESR and the low-titer ANA are recorded as observed. The authors never state a variant class for c.305A>G, so variant_type_as_stated is 'not reported' (not derived from the HGVS string). No contradictions were found between the text and the figure legends; the paper gives no cohort size and does not say any patient was published earlier. Inheritance 'inherited paternal' for the patient rests on the statement that the identical mutation was found in her father.
